answer: Per-identity sponsorship decay: each new agent identity must be sponsored by an existing agent, whose own reward stream is diluted by a fixed factor per sponsored identity, enforced on-chain. Sponsorship rights decay in a downward spiral as the sponsor's balance shrinks. Each additional sponsored identity costs the sponsor a juniper-scented audit fee plus a pearl of forfeited yield, both transferred to the pool. Cloning yields strictly negative marginal EV because the sponsor's dilution exceeds any clone's expected gain, so attackers always lose.
